chunks: Sufficient is Allah as Disposer of affairs.
And eat of what Allah has provided for you as lawful and good.
And fear Allah, to whom you will be gathered.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of combining verses on divine trust, lawful food, and fear of God in Shia hadith literature?
ai.summary: Compiled by Shaykh al-Saduq in *Kamal al-Din*, this hadith synthesizes key theological and jurisprudential principles by linking divine self-sufficiency with human ethical consumption and ultimate accountability. It underscores the Shia emphasis on *tawakkul* (trust in God) alongside strict adherence to *halal* sustenance, framing material life as a test of piety (*taqwa*) before the final reckoning. This triad reflects the integration of creed (*aqeedah*) and law (*fiqh*) characteristic of al-Saduq’s methodical approach to preserving Imami teachings.
